snippet.title: PuppetShow: Destiny Undone
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/ZEdCF2
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/1rcYZi7

Try this immersive, high-quality game for FREE! Then continue on with a ONE TIME unlock and play offline! 
NO VIRTUAL ITEMS, NO INTERRUPTIONS… you’ll OWN this game for life. 

You’re drawn back to the town of Joyville where puppets animate, mischievous spider-like robots prowl, and evil lurks in the shadows. Only you can discover the truth that haunts your loved ones. 

• JOYVILLE IS IN DANGER ONCE AGAIN! 
Cricks is up to his old tricks, your friend has disappeared and the people of Joyville are acting oddly. It’s up to you to put a stop to the chaos. 

• HELP FELICIA SAVE HER FATHER! 
The puppet master has gone missing and Felicia is acting strangely. Can you discover what’s happening and rescue your old friends? 

• EARN A CHARMING HELPER 
A robot with a puppet head, a ruff, and a pleasant demeanor will help you reach difficult items. Find objects to expand his closet. 

• UNLOCK THIS UNIQUE COLLECTOR’S EDITION TO ACCESS EXTRAS! 
Uncover 10 puppets to fill your theater and find items to dress your little robot-helper. Continue on in the bonus chapter and take a step behind the scenes with the beautiful concept art in this fantastic Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure!
